_comment: Static metadata for the 9 Space Gods (Set 17). The Stage 2-4 / 3-4 / 4-4 Offerings were transcribed manually from in-game God's Overview screenshots in 2026-06-10 — Riot doesn't ship them as structured data anywhere. baseApiName pins the Stage 4-7 final boon (TFT17_Augment_<id>GodAugment*) so we can split it visually from the variants. Source for offerings: ingame UI screenshots stored in c:/Users/dtaub/Desktop/Metastats/God's Overview/.
